title: Homology Searches Using Prochlorococcus Genomes
author: Frank O Aylward
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.x8xfrxn

steps.title: Download Prochlorococcus Bacteriophage Genomes
steps.instruction: Use the wget command to download the compressed genomic FASTA files from the NCBI server.

steps.title: Decompress Genomic Files
steps.instruction: Uncompress the downloaded gzip files using the gunzip command.

substeps.instruction: Verify files are present using the 'ls' command.

steps.title: Predict Genes and Proteins
steps.instruction: Use Prodigal to predict genes and proteins from the unzipped genomic FASTA files.

substeps.instruction: Run: prodigal -i PSSM2.fna -a PSSM2.faa -d PSSM2.genes.fna -f gff -o PSSM2.gff
Run: prodigal -i PSSM3.fna -a PSSM3.faa -d PSSM3.genes.fna -f gff -o PSSM3.gff

steps.title: Analyze Sequence Statistics
steps.instruction: Obtain basic sequence statistics for the predicted protein files using seqkit.

steps.title: Create BLAST Protein Database
steps.instruction: Format a protein FASTA file as a reference database using makeblastdb.

steps.title: Perform Initial BLASTP Search
steps.instruction: Run a BLASTP search using one protein file as the query and the formatted database as the reference.

steps.title: Perform Refined BLASTP Search
steps.instruction: Run BLASTP with specific filters to obtain a tab-delimited output of the best hits with high-stringency thresholds.

steps.title: Quantify Protein Homologs
steps.instruction: Count the number of proteins in the query genome that have hits in the reference genome using the wc command.

steps.title: Calculate Average Amino Acid Identity (AAI)
steps.instruction: Calculate the average percent identity of the best hits using datamash.

substeps.instruction: Run: blastp -query PSSM3.faa -db PSSM2.faa -outfmt 6 -max_target_seqs 1 -evalue 0.00001 -max_hsps 1 -qcov_hsp_perc 50 | datamash mean 3
